dashboard.title: Transcoding Tasks
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor and manage your active and queued media processing tasks.
dashboard.no_tasks_desc: You haven't created any transcoding tasks yet. Get started by uploading some media.

new_task.title: Create New Task
new_task.subtitle: Upload media files and configure bulk transcoding parameters.
new_task.params_subtitle: Configure image optimization and transcoding parameters

dimensions.title: Dimensions & Resolution Limit
dimensions.subtitle: Downscaling resolution is the most direct lever to shrink file sizes.
dimensions.aspect_ratio_hint: Preserves aspect ratio using linear-light Lanczos3 resampling. Never stretches, no upscaling.

new_task.quality_desc: Higher quality values result in better details but larger file sizes.
new_task.no_files_desc: Drag and drop files here, or click "Add Files" to browse.

expert.speed_desc: 0 is slowest (highest compression), 10 is fastest (larger size).
expert.sharp_yuv_desc: Improve edge details and color matching
expert.chroma_subsampling_desc: Output chroma subsampling format. 4:2:0 is recommended for compatibility.
expert.jobs_desc: Specify maximum encoding threads. Default uses all available cores.
expert.alpha_quality_toggle_desc: Enable customized quality setting specifically for the transparency channel
expert.sharpness_desc: Sharpness of the transform blocks (0-7, default 0). Higher values reduce blur on line-art.
expert.color_sharpness_desc: Sharpness specifically for color channels (0-7). Higher values help with color bleeding.
expert.alpha_sharpness_desc: Sharpness specifically for the alpha transparency channel (0-7).
expert.method_desc: 0 is fastest, 6 is slowest/best quality compression.
expert.compression_level_desc: 0 is uncompressed (largest file), 9 is max compression.

jxl.lossless_desc: For JPEG inputs, this automatically enables zero-loss reconstruction, shrinking files by ~20% with absolute bit-level reversibility. For non-JPEG inputs (e.g., PNG), it enforces pixel-level modular lossless encoding.
jxl.distance_desc: 0.1 is visually perfect/nearly lossless. Higher values mean smaller files and higher degradation (max 15.0).
jxl.preserve_jpeg_desc: Avoid double-compression loss for JPEG inputs by automatically applying lossless reconstruction.

metadata.title: Metadata & Privacy Policy
metadata.subtitle: Choose which metadata (EXIF / ICC) to preserve or sanitize.
metadata.policy_preserve_desc: Keep ICC and valid EXIF tags intact while auto-orienting rotation.
metadata.policy_strip_desc: Remove GPS, device models and embedded profiles for privacy and smaller size.

strict_mode.title: Strict Mode
strict_mode.desc: Fail explicitly if the external codec is unavailable instead of silent fallback.

color_pipeline.title: Color & Dynamic Range
color_pipeline.subtitle: Auto-preserves color gamut & HDR by default. Switch output intent or customize overrides.
color_pipeline.subtitle_v2: Color correctness is guaranteed automatically with zero manual matrix tuning.
color_pipeline.mode_auto_desc: Keep native primaries, transfer curve and HDR tags. Zero color shift.
color_pipeline.mode_auto_desc_v2: Preserves wide-gamut and HDR dynamic range without color distortion.
color_pipeline.mode_sdr_desc: Tone-map wide-gamut / HDR content into standard sRGB 8-bit.
color_pipeline.mode_sdr_desc_v2: Applies filmic tone-mapping to compress HDR/P3 into sRGB 8-bit.
color_pipeline.dither_active_notice: Blue noise dithering automatically active to prevent 8-bit banding
color_pipeline.chroma_fidelity_warning: Note: Upsampling 4:2:2/4:2:0 to 4:4:4 will not recover already lost chroma detail.
color_pipeline.detected_desc: Read from image metadata; locked by default to prevent accidental override.
color_pipeline.advanced_overrides_desc: Manually override input color space tags, chroma subsampling or tone mapping curve.
color_pipeline.source_space_desc: Only override if the source file lacks tags or was tagged incorrectly.
color_pipeline.policy_strip_warning: Warning: Stripping ICC profiles can cause color deviations or muted tones across non-calibrated displays.
color_pipeline.bit_depth_hint: Dithering is automatically applied when stepping down to 8-bit to eliminate banding.
color_pipeline.chroma_hint: Auto automatically selects 4:4:4 for UI/text and 4:2:0 for photos.
color_pipeline.tone_mapping_disabled_hdr: HDR passthrough is enabled; tone mapping is not needed.
color_pipeline.tone_mapping_hint: Applied when converting HDR sources to standard SDR.
color_pipeline.dither_hint: Prevents color banding when converting 10/16-bit sources down to 8-bit.
color_pipeline.format_no_wide_color: {format} does not support wide-gamut tags or 10-bit; will be mapped to sRGB.

task_detail.toast_download_link_failed: Failed to retrieve secure download link
task_detail.completed_banner_desc: Successfully processed {count} file(s), saving {saved} ({ratio}%) of total storage space.
task_detail.processing_banner_desc: The cloud engine is actively processing your files. Progress auto-syncs live...
task_detail.failed_banner_desc: {count} job(s) encountered issues during transcoding. Check below for details.
task_detail.toast_retry_all_success: Retry initiated for all failed jobs
task_detail.retry_modal_desc: Modify output format and compression parameters before re-triggering transcoding.
task_detail.cancel_dialog_desc: Cancelling will abort all pending and processing transcoding jobs immediately. Completed files will not be affected.
task_detail.cancelled_banner_desc: All pending and running jobs in this task were aborted. You can restart all jobs anytime.

wasm_sandbox.title: Local Image Transcoding
wasm_sandbox.subtitle: Process, optimize and transform images in real-time entirely in your browser using high-performance Rust WebAssembly.
wasm_sandbox.drag_prompt: Drag & drop your image here, or click to browse
wasm_sandbox.drag_sub: Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP up to 50MB
wasm_sandbox.memory_warning: Warning: Large image detected. Processing in WebAssembly may use significant browser memory and take a few seconds.
wasm_sandbox.awaiting_image: Upload a source image to configure editing operations
wasm_sandbox.quality_desc: Controls output compression quality. Does not apply to lossless formats.
wasm_sandbox.webp_info: Pure Rust WebP encoding in this environment is mathematically lossless. The quality setting is not applicable.
wasm_sandbox.jxl_info: Images are encoded in the browser via libjxl with lossy compression — the quality slider applies. Lossless JPEG reconstruction is only available in the server pipeline.
wasm_sandbox.drop_to_queue: Drop image to append to queue
wasm_sandbox.formats_supported: Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, JXL formats
wasm_sandbox.click_to_replace: Click here to replace the current input image
wasm_sandbox.auto_process_desc: Whether to process in real-time when parameters change
wasm_sandbox.drag_to_replace_hint: Tip: Drag and drop a new image here to quickly replace
wasm_sandbox.resize_hint: Tip: Images maintain original size by default. When enabled, width & height act as maximum constraints to scale proportionally.
